description: Manager action schemas for A7-RT board control. All actions require intent. DISPATCH, REDISPATCH, and COMMIT additionally require manager_note. INLINED for Fireworks compatibility (no $ref).

function.name: submit_action
function.description: Submit exactly one manager action for the current turn. The harness validates the action against live board state and rejects invalid actions with last_error. Use OBSERVE/DECIDE format in content, then call this tool with structured parameters.

action_type.description: Action to execute. Must be one of the 9 valid opcodes.

oneOf.title: DispatchParams
oneOf.description: DISPATCH: Send a ready node to a subagent for work. Node must be in board.ready.

node_id.description: ID of node to dispatch. Must be present in board.ready.

role.description: REQUIRED role selection by node status: near+feature→test_author (contract MUST be defined first), provisional→builder, glue/test→builder, [ANALYZE]→analyst. CRITICAL: Dispatching builder on near+feature will fail—test_author must create test contract before builder can implement.

weight.description: Protocol weight. none=ceiling provisional, lean=default, full=escalated, a7=analyst only. Escalate if prior escalate:true, >5 dependents, or avg_iterations>3.

intent.description: Required. One sentence: what you're doing and why. Example: 'Highest ready node, no tests yet'.

manager_note.description: Required strategic guidance to subagent. What to check, retry approach, or concerns. Example: 'Check error handling'.

focus_hints.description: Optional. Specific aspects to focus on during dispatch.

view_spec.description: Optional. View specification for context assembly.

clear_findings.description: Optional. Clear prior analyst findings for this node.

scope.description: Required for analyst role. Examination scope.

query.description: Required for analyst role. Question to investigate.

target_nodes.description: For analyst role. Node IDs to examine.

oneOf.title: RedispatchParams
oneOf.description: REDISPATCH: Retry a failed or poisoned node. Node must be in valid_dispatch_targets. Never REDISPATCH if wild_counts[node_id] >= 2.

node_id.description: ID of node to redispatch. Must be in board.valid_dispatch_targets or be a poisoned root.

weight.description: Protocol weight for retry. Do not de-escalate without human approval.

manager_note.description: Required. What failed and what to do differently.

clear_findings.description: Optional. Clear prior analyst findings before redispatch.

oneOf.title: ValidateParams
oneOf.description: VALIDATE: Accept a subagent return from pending_returns. Runs schema validation.

node_id.description: ID of node to validate. Must be in board.pending_returns.

oneOf.title: CommitParams
oneOf.description: COMMIT: Finalize a node from pending_commits. Address analyst_findings before COMMIT grounded.

node_id.description: ID of node to commit. Must be in board.pending_commits.

status.description: Target status. grounded=implementation complete, provisional=test contract defined, suspended=blocked.

clear_findings.description: Optional. Clear analyst findings after commit.

oneOf.title: SuspendParams
oneOf.description: SUSPEND: Block a node due to external dependency or epistemic limit.

type.description: near=dependency not grounded, far=external data needed, void=no implementable surface, wild=schema failure.

oneOf.title: ConsultParams
oneOf.description: CONSULT: Ask A7 oracle for architectural guidance. Do not CONSULT twice without reading pending_consult verdict.

relevant_node_ids.description: Node IDs relevant to the question.

oneOf.title: UpdatePlanParams
oneOf.description: UPDATE_PLAN: Update manager planning state with narrative and/or checklist.

narrative.description: Optional. Planning narrative describing current approach.

oneOf.title: SealParams
oneOf.description: SEAL: Complete and archive current stage. Preconditions: No near nodes, no unverified assumption edges, pending_returns empty, pending_commits empty.

oneOf.title: HaltParams
oneOf.description: HALT: Stop execution. Use when: invariant violated, no valid action, wild_counts >= 2, contradictory CONSULT verdict, max_turns approaching.

invariant.description: Optional. Specific invariant violated if applicable.

parameters.description: Action-specific parameters. Structure depends on action_type. All actions require 'intent'. DISPATCH/REDISPATCH/COMMIT additionally require 'manager_note'.
